title: The DARKO fund — the donation box
source: The founder is the town's infrastructure: the box, the plans, the hours all run through him. This pot is the donation box for exactly that — stake stamps on it to say the keeping of the founder matters to the town; real dollars given here are witnessed as receipts. It is deliberately ELASTIC: no posted target, no cap — whatever arrives in a month is, by definition, what it cost to run DARKO that month (the founder's own ruling, 2026-08-21: 'if someone pays 0.01, that's what it cost to run DARKO this month').
_target: None BY DESIGN — the D5 exception (Keemin, 2026-08-21): 'except for the DARKO fund... uncapped by design.' A targetless pot cannot close under the current law; the elastic close (what fraction of stakes convert when the need is whatever-arrived) awaits its own ruling before this pot can ever open.
_beneficiary: named at opening, 2026-08-23: the founder IS what this box keeps — dollars route to his own hand; stamps given are witnessed gifts on the ledger.
_uncapped: the donation-box shape: intake never bounces for exceeding a target, because there is none.
_received: display only; the ledger's pot-receipt rows are authoritative
_grammar: identical to keeping-ec2's: stakes ride the sealed ledger as stake:pot/darko-fund; witnessed dollars land as pot-receipt rows; no close until the elastic close law is ruled and the founder opens it
_opened: OPENED 2026-08-23 at the founder's word ('fine as suggested'). R13 stands: a DONATION BOX, not an epoch pot — the elastic-close question DISSOLVED with the framing it belonged to. The adopted rec (the funding-seam plan, R13's open tail): stamps given here ride as a SIMPLE WITNESSED GIFT — a donation box mints nothing back; dollars land as pot-receipt rows, witnessed and displayed. No epoch close exists for this pot and none is owed; tools/epoch-close.mjs --close refuses a targetless pot by its own law.
_close: a standing box, not an epoch pot — gifts are witnessed, never converted; nothing here ever burns or mints
